verdict.rationale: Claude Code documents a dedicated sandboxed Bash tool providing OS-enforced filesystem and network isolation, letting the agent run commands autonomously within defined boundaries rather than requiring per-command approval, directly matching the engineering-lead's review-safety need. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the sandbox's robustness, coverage of non-Bash tool sandboxing, and more detail on configuring granular network/file allowlists.
